decision: stateful campaign captures plus bounded lease-expiry waits with explicit fencing evidence
problem: The Qubes campaign harness can now exercise same-worker stale-token fencing, but the readiness report previously only counted accepted stale completions. A report with staleCompletions=0 could therefore pass without proving that a stale-token completion was actually attempted or that the replacement lease completed successfully.

approaches.name: infer fencing success from staleCompletions=0
approaches.lesson: Absence of a stale acceptance is not evidence that the stale-token path was exercised.

approaches.name: explicit stale-probe rejection plus current-lease completion evidence
approaches.latency: no additional qrexec calls beyond the canonical fencing sequence
approaches.lesson: Readiness should prove both halves of fencing: the old token loses authority and the new token retains authority.

approaches.name: external attestation service for every fencing transition
approaches.latency: higher due to extra service/attestation calls
approaches.lesson: Cryptographic attestation may be justified later, but it adds infrastructure before the real Qubes boundary has passed the simpler deterministic evidence gate.

harness: every stale_probe emits stale_completion_probe with rejected=true/false
accepted stale probes continue to emit stale_completion as a blocker
the canonical reclaimed-token completion is marked fencingCurrentCompletion and emits current_lease_completion only after a successful coordinator response
readinessGate: requires at least one stale-token probe
requires every stale-token probe to be rejected
requires at least one successful current-lease completion
retains existing zero staleCompletions, duplicate mutation, unresolved request and QA-before-join gates

priorIntegrationFailure.observed: DIG Node QA #169 failed only in qubes-qrexec-campaign-harness.test.mjs because the harness emitted a bounded wait event that the collector rejected as unsupported.
priorIntegrationFailure.rootCause: The campaign-control event contract was extended in the harness without extending the collector schema.
priorIntegrationFailure.lesson: Any harness event-contract extension must update collector and readiness tests in the same change set.

added: rejected stale probe increments probe and rejection evidence
accepted stale probe increments probe evidence but not rejection evidence and remains a blocker
current reclaimed lease completion emits explicit success evidence
readiness fails when the stale path was never probed
readiness fails when any stale probe was accepted
readiness fails when no current lease completion succeeded
expectedRealQubesSequence: claim mission and capture old lease token
reclaim with the same workerId and capture a new lease token
attempt completion with old token and require explicit rejection evidence
complete with new token and require explicit success evidence

safety: Synthetic and defensive worker reliability testing only; no real financial operations or external side effects.
